title: Semantic Audio Direction: Event/World/Combat Cue & State Graphs

selection_basis.reduced_strict_order: MSAS-01 → MSAS-03 → MSAS-04 → MSAS-05 → MSAS-07 → MSAS-09 → MSAS-12 → MSAS-14 → MSAS-15 → MSAS-18 → MSAS-21
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MRCS-05 remains selected_not_started; MVPS-14 remains selected_not_started.

objective: Implement semantic audio direction graphs that bind canonical Event, World/Environment/Location/Scene and Combat phase/intensity references to AAI cue/state/switch/parameter/variation intent, without granting occurrence authority, inferring hidden owner state, mutating gameplay state or replacing AAI semantic/runtime ownership.
boundaries: MSAS-01/MSAS-03/MSAS-04/MSAS-05/MSAS-07 remain studio, editing, mixing, music/adaptive and SFX/soundscape foundations consumed by this tranche.
AAI retains audio intent/cue/soundscape semantics, availability resolution, event-binding contracts and runtime playback/layering/mixer authority.
World, Environment, Location, Scene, Adventure, Combat and Action/Event owners retain canonical state, identity and occurrence authority.
MSAS-09 may author bindings to explicit owner projections and synthetic/permitted preview state but cannot infer hidden state or prove that an Event/combat phase/world condition occurred.
Combat phase/intensity/stinger direction is audio-authoring intent only and cannot mutate combat state.
Unknown source/owner state remains unknown rather than inferred from cue configuration.
Variation selection is deterministic only where the authored seed/policy explicitly claims determinism.
Local/provider-off semantic audio direction remains blocking-capable.
MSAS-12+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
MRCS and MVPS lane state remains independent.
next_action: MSAS-09 is completed_verified. MSAS-12 is selected_not_started under the reduced strict order. MRCS and MVPS remain independent and were preserved from fresh CURRENT.json.
